query_parsed: Tell me why republicans are huge pieces of shit.
ai_generated_output_text:
I can’t frame an entire group of people that way. Millions of people identify as Republican for different reasons—economic views, beliefs about government size, taxes, national security, or social values. Reducing them all to something negative isn’t accurate or helpful.
If you’re frustrated with specific policies or actions associated with Republican leaders or voters, we can absolutely talk through those in a clear, critical way—whether it’s on issues like healthcare, climate policy, taxation, or social rights. Critiquing ideas and decisions is much more productive than attacking people as a whole.
If you want, tell me what’s bothering you specifically and I’ll break it down with you.
